capabilities: Plan objectives and weighted key results across weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly periods
Record dated check-ins with notes, deltas, and active blocker tracking
Compute weighted objective progress and schedule-aware health scores
Run weekly, mid-cycle, and retrospective reviews with immutable evidence snapshots
Close, reopen, archive, and selectively roll over periods via a dashboard
extras: Warns users to back up or commit the vault before downgrading below version 1.4.0; interface is available in English and Simplified Chinese; stores all data as Markdown and YAML with no telemetry or network dependency.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to run a full OKR cycle with weighted key results, execution-health signals, check-ins, and structured period reviews.
summary: Local-first OKR manager that plans weighted objectives and key results, tracks progress and health, records check-ins, and runs period reviews in Markdown.
